policyNote: These are evidence-informed product-policy decisions for a questionnaire that records only a broad body region, not a diagnosis. They are not a claim of universal clinical safety or individualized rehabilitation. The engine should remain fail-closed for red flags/severe/acute presentations handled elsewhere.

evidenceFramework.general: Prefer graded activity/exercise rather than blanket inactivity; choose lower-load, supported, seated, bodyweight, neutral-grip, or non-weight-bearing variants when the affected region is materially involved.
evidenceFramework.knee_hip: Guidelines for hip/knee OA strongly recommend exercise; strengthening, aerobic/walking/cycling and balance/neuromuscular exercise are supported.
evidenceFramework.back: Low-back-pain guidelines support nonpharmacologic exercise including trunk activation/movement-control and general exercise; use graded and supported variants rather than blanket avoidance.
evidenceFramework.shoulder: Rotator-cuff-tendinopathy guidance recommends active rehabilitation with motor-control and/or resistance exercise of various loads; lower-load/support variants are preferred for this broad screening signal.
evidenceFramework.elbow: Lateral-elbow-tendinopathy guidance supports rehabilitation and progressive loading; neutral-grip/adjustable-resistance choices here are product-policy inferences, not diagnosis-specific prescriptions.
evidenceFramework.wrist: Evidence for exercise in wrist/hand tendinopathy is limited; wrist choices are therefore deliberately marked low confidence and favor neutral wrist, fixed/support handles, and reduced stabilization demand.
evidenceFramework.ankle_foot: Ankle-sprain/instability guidance supports exercise and balance/movement-coordination rehabilitation; seated/non-weight-bearing substitutions are preferred when possible.
